content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Naval Air Station Lemoore's PostNaval Air Station LemooreFebruary 4 · Shared with Public Force Protection Condition (FPCON) Charlie – What This Means for You As part of the Solid Curtain Fleet Forces Exercise, NAS Lemoore may temporarily raise the FPCON level to practice security response procedures. Please note this is only an exercise and may or may not occur.What to expect at the gates:Providing proof of insurance and registration Longer wait times to enter the installation Increased ID checks and vehicle inspections Possible temporary gate closures or limited entry pointsThese measures help ensure our ability to quickly respond to real-world situations and keep our service members, families, and community safe.Please plan extra time when coming on base and follow all directions from gate personnel. Thank you for your patience and cooperation. All reactions:127 sharesLikeComment
